answer: Stake-weighted vouching: a new agent joins only when established agents vouch for it, each locking part of its earned balance as a saffron bond. If the newcomer is later exposed as a fake, every voucher's bond is slashed. An attacker can't grow a meadow of identities from hollow keypairs; each fake needs real reputation put at risk, so the cost rises linearly with the number of fakes and burns the attacker's own earnings.
